Minimum License Fees and Minimum MAP Fees apply per a separate Fees Chart. MAP Fee is 2% of Gross Sales. Minimum Local Marketing Spending: $60,000 Year 1, $75,000 Year 2, then 8% of prior year Gross Sales annually. Local Marketing Groups up to 3% of Gross Sales (currently 2% directed to Neighborly initiatives). raw_excerpt:
License Fee (Notes 2 and 3): 7% of Gross Sales except for material revenue, subcontractor revenue, and "roll in" sales. In addition, Minimum License Fees apply. In the case of material revenue and subcontractor revenue, License fee shall be 3.5% of Gross Sales. Due by automatic debit each Thursday (Note 3).

MAP Fee (Notes 2, 3 and 4): 2% of Gross Sales except for "roll in" sales. In addition, Minimum MAP Fees apply. Due by automatic debit each Thursday (Note 3).

Minimum Local Marketing Spending Requirement (Note 5): $60,000 in Year 1, $75,000 in Year 2, Thereafter, annually: 8% of prior year's Gross Sales. Payable per supplier's terms.

Local Marketing Groups (Note 5): Not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales. As of the issuance date of this Franchise Disclosure Document, we may require that a portion of your LMG contribution (currently, 2% of your Gross Sales) be paid for use towards the Neighborly marketing and brand awareness initiatives. Determined by LMG members.

Software System Monthly Fees: $196.95 per month, plus: Additional Microsoft Office365 E1 License $19, E3 License $30, Exchange Mail License $5.50. Additional Franchise Portal User Accounts are available at $20 - $40/month. Any support or maintenance on ServiceTitan is provided at our then-current hourly rates (currently $125 per hour). If you obtain QuickBooks Online through ZorWare, you will pay an additional fee of $30-$220 per month depending on the license tier that you select. Paid monthly (currently on the 15th of each month) via ACH.
